name: inference-workers
cmd: for p in $(ss -H -ltn | awk '{print $4}' | sed -n 's/.*:\(114[34][0-9]\)$/\1/p' | grep -vx 11435 | sort -u); do curl -fsS -m 300 http://127.0.0.1:$p/api/generate -d '{"model":"qwen2.5-coder:7b","prompt":"Reply with the single word: ok","stream":false,"options":{"num_predict":8}}' -o "$X3_JOB_OUT/worker-$p.json" || { echo "worker :$p failed"; exit 1; }; echo "worker :$p ok"; done; ls "$X3_JOB_OUT"/worker-*.json
label: PHYSICAL

rejected_workers.reason: unreachable or SSH key auth failed
